description: This file contains utility functions and classes for CUDA code generation and CUTLASS integration within PyTorch's Inductor compiler, including cache management, dynamic import handling, and CUDA architecture normalization.

classes.name: CUTLASSArgs
classes.description: Data class holding arguments for initializing a CUTLASS Manifest.

classes.name: CUDACompileSourceCapturingContext
classes.description: Helper class for capturing CUDA source code during compilation for testing and benchmarking.

methods.name: move_cutlass_compiled_cache
methods.description: Moves the CUTLASS compiled cache file to the cache directory if it exists.

methods.name: try_import_cutlass
methods.description: Attempts to import CUTLASS Python modules, supporting different build environments.

methods.name: gen_ops
methods.description: Generates all supported CUTLASS operations based on current CUDA architecture and version.

methods.name: torch_dtype_to_cutlass_type
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch dtype to the corresponding CUTLASS DataType.

methods.name: dtype_match
methods.description: Checks if a PyTorch dtype matches a given CUTLASS DataType.

methods.name: get_accumulator_dtype
methods.description: Infers the appropriate accumulator dtype for a pair of input dtypes.

methods.name: get_alignments
methods.description: Returns valid CUTLASS alignment options for a given dtype.

methods.name: get_max_alignment
methods.description: Calculates the maximum data alignment for a given Inductor layout.

methods.name: cuda_standalone_runner_compile_command
methods.description: Generates a command to compile CUDA GEMM kernel source into a standalone executable.
